Economy · India

AI's impact on jobs, investment, and industry growth explored

The artificial intelligence boom is reshaping the workforce, with Uber cutting customer support jobs due to AI integration. Simultaneously, the sector is experiencing a surge in investment, with cybersecurity startups seeing funding nearly double to $89 million in the first half of 2026. Concerns persist about the sustainability of the AI boom, with warnings that a collapse of a major player like OpenAI could trigger an industry-wide downturn. India is also investing heavily in semiconductor development, committing over ₹2 trillion to build a global chip hub, with success dependent on talent, infrastructure, and innovation.
